charts.title: Load · actual vs forecast

charts.title: Wind & solar capture rates

charts.title: Forecast · solar, wind and load, today and tomorrow
charts.desc: Day-ahead forecasts of solar, wind and load published by the grid operators, quarter-hourly, for today and tomorrow, with what has happened so far today. The forecast part is hatched and labelled; the note gives the usual error over the last 30 days.

charts.title: France · day-ahead price and chance of a negative price, today and tomorrow
charts.desc: For each hour of today and tomorrow, the chance that the French day-ahead price is below zero: residual demand once solar, wind and the nuclear available are served, the same for Germany, the solar share, the calendar; a logistic model on the last three years. Its record since January 2025 is given under the chart. Where the price is already known, the real price is drawn.
charts.source: PowerKlock model on RTE éCO2mix history and TSO day-ahead forecasts

charts.title: France · PowerKlock combined forecast, solar and wind
charts.desc: Solar and wind output of France for today and tomorrow: PowerKlock’s forecast (the forecast tool’s physics at 15 points weighted by the fleet, with the TSO forecast as an input), its P10–P90 band, the TSO forecast and the actual output so far. Walk-forward since 2024 it beats the TSO forecast alone.
charts.source: PowerKlock model on Open-Meteo and the TSO day-ahead forecast

charts.title: Tomorrow · forecast output and load
charts.desc: Tomorrow’s forecast wind and solar output (GWh), load and residual load (average GW), against today; flagged as a forecast with its usual error.
